interpretation.sourceStringsPolicy: Keep every source spelling and its paper/table location verbatim. Store candidate names only in this separately attributed crosswalk; do not rewrite the article, merge count rows, or infer specimen identity.
limits: The catalogs establish name status or a spelling relation, not fish identification, locality, abundance, habitat use, or current presence in Bolinao.

The source paper reports underwater photographs for identification support but no linked image set, voucher number, or accession was reviewed; no author-confirmed mapping from the variant strings to organisms is available.
The source paper's 2009 survey is historical and this crosscheck does not establish present access, current MPA boundaries, fishing rules, water safety, or catchability.
WoRMS pages display CC BY-NC 4.0 at the individual taxon pages reviewed. No images, table data, or bulk records were copied; public-app projection remains disabled pending rights review.

nextAction: Keep the source review and name crosswalk linked. If a public checklist is later needed, obtain specimen/author confirmation and a separate rights decision for the article-derived data; continue Region I discovery across inland waters, estuaries, and other coastal studies.
